description: This PHP source file defines the ConsoleInvestListener class, which listens to investment refund events and handles refund cancellation, refund return, and refund failure for investments within the Goteo project. It utilizes event-driven architecture to respond to specific console events related to investments.

classes.name: ConsoleInvestListener
classes.description: A listener class that handles investment refund events such as cancellations, refunds, and failures by responding to console events.

methods.name: onInvestRefundCancel
methods.description: Handles the cancellation of an investment refund, logs the action, and updates the investment record accordingly.

methods.name: onInvestRefundReturn
methods.description: Handles successful refund return, logs the event, and updates the investment record.

methods.name: onInvestRefundFailed
methods.description: Handles failed refund attempts, logs the failure, and updates the investment details.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping console events to handler methods.
